About Cherng Talay

Cherng Talay (Choeng Thale) is a subdistrict of Thalang district that stretches from the west-coast beaches inland. In everyday use the name also covers the residential streets behind Bang Tao, Laguna and Layan, which is why several of our beach-area pages are neighbours of this one.

Projects listed here carry Cherng Talay as their primary location: villas and condominiums. International schools and Boat Avenue appear in the project data; distances are measured from the named project.

Why buyers choose Cherng Talay

  • Within a short drive of Bang Tao, Laguna and Layan
  • Many villa estates and new condos
  • Schools, supermarkets and clinics nearby
  • Generally lower prices than beachfront areas

Neighbouring areas in our catalogue: Bang Tao · Laguna · Layan · Si Sunthon

Lifestyle and amenities

Cherng Talay is residential, with local markets, supermarkets, international schools, gyms and attractions such as Blue Tree within easy reach. Most residents drive to the beaches and Boat Avenue.

Beaches and surroundings

The closest beaches are Bang Tao and Layan, typically 1 to 5 km from projects in our catalogue. Surin and Kamala are further south.

Rental demand in Cherng Talay

Cherng Talay is mainly a long-term rental market for families and residents who work or study nearby, with some holiday demand for pool villas.

Long-term rentals

Families, teachers and professionals look for villas and condos near schools and the Bang Tao amenities.

Short-term holiday rentals

Pool villas with good facilities can let to holiday groups, but inland locations depend on price and quality.

Suitable property types

Two- to four-bedroom pool villas and practical condos.

Advantages and limitations

Advantage: value and space close to the west coast. Limitations: no beach on foot; heavy new-build supply.

General market observations, not verified statistics. No rental income or occupancy is guaranteed; developer-advertised returns are not market results.

Rental and investment in Cherng Talay

Buyers consider Cherng Talay for more space and lower prices than the beachfront while staying close to Bang Tao and Laguna. It is well suited to family homes and long-term letting.

Typical investor profiles

Families buying a home, buyers of villas for long-term rental.

Risks to consider

Many similar villa estates; check build quality, land title and the developer's completed projects.

Ownership costs

Villa maintenance, pool and garden care, common fees in managed estates, insurance.

Cherng Talay: frequently asked questions

Where is Cherng Talay in Phuket?

Cherng Talay (Choeng Thale) is a subdistrict in Thalang district on the west coast. It includes the Bang Tao, Laguna, Layan and Surin areas and the inland roads behind them.

Is Cherng Talay close to the beach?

Projects in our catalogue are typically 1 to 5 km from Bang Tao or Layan Beach.

Is Cherng Talay good for families?

Yes, it is popular with families because of the international schools, supermarkets and clinics nearby and the space of villa estates.

How far is Cherng Talay from the airport?

Our project data puts projects about 13 to 21 km from Phuket International Airport.

Are villas cheaper in Cherng Talay than in Bang Tao?

Inland villas in Cherng Talay generally have lower starting prices than beachfront or Laguna properties; compare the advertised prices on this page.

How much does property in Cherng Talay cost?

Advertised starting prices for projects in Cherng Talay run from ฿3,200,000 to ฿37,360,000 (10 of 11 projects publish a price). These are lowest advertised prices; ask us to confirm current availability.
